introduction: The Eagle Nebula changes appearance across multiple infrared bands recorded by Spitzer.
observe: Compare which regions brighten or recede between the infrared views.
Look for features that persist even as the color mapping changes.
explanation: The source presents the nebula in different hues of infrared light and emphasizes that each view carries different information.
colorMethod: Visible display colors distinguish infrared wavelength combinations; they are not the unaided-eye colors of the nebula.
whyItMatters: Infrared is not one uniform view. Selecting bands changes which structures and materials become easiest to read.
